text:
Hi everyone! Has anyone had a similar experience?
We’re both Argentine. My husband has been an Israeli citizen for several years, and I moved to Israel two years ago. We got married in Argentina six months ago, but when we tried to register our marriage here, they refused our documents.

They told us that the apostille must include the name of the judge who married us (which doesn’t make sense), and that we must provide the “original” marriage certificate—even though in Argentina you are only given an official certified copy, not the original record.

In May, they renewed my B1 visa and scheduled our A5 interview for December, when we’re supposed to submit this document.

Has anyone dealt with the same requirements? How did you manage to resolve it?
